versions.subject: New Rules: transformed elastic to sigma rules
versions.detection:
selection_name:
    - Image|endswith: '\vssadmin.exe'
    - OriginalFilename: 'VSSADMIN.EXE'
selection_args:
    commandLine|contains:
        - 'delete'
        - 'resize'
selection_shadow:
    CommandLine|contains: 'shadows'
condition: all of selection*
versions.spl: Image="*\\vssadmin.exe" OR OriginalFilename="VSSADMIN.EXE" commandLine IN ("*delete*", "*resize*") CommandLine="*shadows*"
